job.title: API Integration Architect / API Governance Expert

tailoring.headline: API & Integration Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud | REST/OCC APIs, SAP ERP/MDM/PIM Integration
tailoring.summary: Integration-focused SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Designs and delivers REST/OCC APIs for headless storefronts and third-party systems, integrates SAP ERP, MDM and PIM via DataHub, Hotfolders and APIs, and works techno-functionally with European stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: The role combines API design, integration architecture and governance on international SAP-centred projects – exactly where my experience with REST/OCC APIs and SAP ERP/MDM/PIM integrations adds value.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Guten Tag Denise Prus, Ihre SAP CX Consultant-Stelle passt sehr gut: 5+ Jahre SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell, Integration mit SAP ERP/MDM/PIM, Anforderungsanalyse. SAP-zertifiziert, Karlsruhe, Start ab 16.12.2026. Gern kurz telefonieren?

en.subject: Application: API Integration Architect / API Governance Expert – Kranti Chavan
en.hook: Your client needs someone who designs and governs secure, reusable APIs between SAP and the surrounding SaaS landscape – that is what I have done for over five years on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: API design and lifecycle
bullets.text: Designed and delivered OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and third-party systems, including API migrations for customer-account structures, with clear contracts and documentation for consuming teams.

bullets.label: SAP and enterprise integration
bullets.text: Built and optimised PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams.

bullets.label: Standards, security and deployment
bullets.text: Applied consistent integration patterns, data models and secure deployment practices through CI/CD on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2); production support and troubleshooting across integrated systems.

bullets.label: Stakeholders and enablement
bullets.text: Techno-functional role between business and IT: requirements analysis, functional specifications, user stories and UAT with European clients in agile, international teams.

en.logistics: I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer, work fully in English and am ready to work remotely across Europe. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start after my notice period on 16.12.2026. I would welcome a short call to discuss how I can support your client.
